title: Beyond ROUGE: N-Gram Subspace Features for LLM Hallucination Detection
why_relevant: Proposes an n-gram tensor feature method for hallucination detection in LLM outputs, evaluated on HaluEval. Not focused on RAG robustness, retrieval reliability, or evidence-based settings.
why_not_or_caveat: Hallucination detection via text features only; does not address noisy/conflicting/adversarial evidence or RAG calibration.
